name: Sanel Auto Parts Co
old_description: It all started in 1920 when Benjamin Sanel and Edward Sanel Sr. founded Sanel Auto Wrecking Company in Concord, NH. Their vision was to supply customers in northern New England with the highest quality car parts in the automotive repair business.
about:
Sanel Auto Parts Co. began in 1920 when Benjamin Sanel and Edward Sanel Sr. founded Sanel Auto Wrecking Company in Concord, New Hampshire. The business remained in the Sanel family and, after a 2018 partnership with NAPA Auto Parts, continues to operate independently as Sanel NAPA.

Today the company functions as a multi-location distributor of automotive parts, heavy-duty truck components, paint and body supplies, tools and equipment. It maintains over 46 stores across New Hampshire, Vermont, Maine and Massachusetts. In addition to distribution, Sanel runs a fully equipped machine shop that provides custom engine rebuilding for automotive, marine, diesel, powersports, performance and restoration applications, and it assembles hydraulic and air‑conditioning hose assemblies on site.

The customer base spans professional mechanics, independent service garages, individual vehicle owners, body shops, collision centers, dealerships, fleets and industrial accounts. The machine shop serves niche markets such as marine, diesel and powersports, while the body‑shop division supplies refinishing products from Axalta and 3M to collision centers and dealerships throughout the region.

Sanel emphasizes its family‑owned structure and a mission to be the best parts store in town. It differentiates itself through a knowledgeable, professionally trained staff, convenient community locations, and specialized capabilities such as the Axalta Acquire Plus EFX color‑matching system, the Axalta VINdicator technology, and a dedicated Sanel Refinish Training Center designed to improve body‑shop productivity.
